purpose: Frozen English development measurement and fake-boundary fixture; never learner acceptance or a seeded lesson
input:
Let's get started.
Could you repeat that, please?
I'll send the notes.

clarify
semantic_checks: All five original items preserved under one durable receipt and atomic publication
Three fixed phrases retain exact wording, defensible situations, real help and justified alternatives only
Reusable frame declares item/day slots, complete reference example, variable response objective and answer-free prompts
Clarify means make clearer: two or three familiar gapped contexts, matched whole-sentence answers and exact spoken references
No invented prior study, preference changes, candidate matches or cross-target answer leakage
One target and schedule per meaning, not per context; first study ungraded, later recall varies contexts
Fresh semantic review and attended reference listening are separate from structural checks

execution.bounds: existing attempt, output, lease and daily-start limits; no automatic model retries or paid API fallback
